description: This file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, specifically handling USD with dynamic decimal precision and optional credits suffix. It ensures consistent display of currency values across the application, with special handling for small and large numbers, and includes a helper for formatting USD with credits.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision based on the value's magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with credits appended, utilizing formatCurrencyAmount with includeCredits set to true.
